description: This PHP class defines a database migration script for version 4.3.1 of the OrangeHRM system. It handles dropping the existing 'ohrm_reset_password' table if it exists and then creates a new 'ohrm_reset_password' table with specific columns and primary key.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Handles database schema migration for version 4.3.1, creating and dropping tables related to password reset functionality.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration: drops existing 'ohrm_reset_password' table if it exists and creates a new one with specific columns.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '4.3.1' for this migration.
